title: AI不是任何国家私产：习近平称其为人类集体智慧，全球南方如何弥合数字鸿沟
speaker: Xi Jinping

segments.en: AI is an invaluable asset that encapsulates humanity's collective wisdom.
segments.zh: 人工智能是凝聚人类集体智慧的宝贵财富。

segments.en: We should practice true multilateralism and recognize the important role of the United Nations.
segments.zh: 我们要践行真正的多边主义，发挥联合国的重要作用。

segments.en: We should enhance alignment and coordination on AI development strategies, governance rules, and technical standards.
segments.zh: 要加强人工智能发展战略、治理规则和技术标准的对接与协调。

segments.en: so as to form a consensus-based global governance framework at an early date to make this frontier technology better benefit humanity.
segments.zh: 早日形成共识驱动的全球治理框架，让这一前沿技术更好造福人类。

segments.en: We must carry out extensive international cooperation and help global south countries with capacity building to bridge the AI and digital divides.
segments.zh: 要开展广泛国际合作，帮助全球南方国家加强能力建设，弥合人工智能和数字鸿沟。

segments.en: promote sustainable development and prevent creating new historical injustice in AI.
segments.zh: 促进可持续发展，防止在人工智能领域制造新的历史不公。
